P1_fx_receipts.question: Can resident individuals receive foreign currency for services or digital exports? Any conversion or repatriation rule?
P1_fx_receipts.answer: Not applicable for this guide. North Korea is under comprehensive UN and US sanctions, and OFAC has issued specific guidance on DPRK IT workers who seek remote freelance work abroad, often under false identities, to generate revenue for the regime. No lawful route exists for a DPRK resident to sell services to foreign clients through global platforms. This guide covers only lawful routes; it does not describe ways around sanctions.

P3_local_gateways.question: Which local payment gateways can an individual or sole trader use to accept online payments?
P3_local_gateways.answer: Global platform availability for Democratic People's Republic of Korea (automated collector snapshots, Oct 2026). Not listed: Stripe (merchant sign-up); Polar (payouts); Whop (payouts); Dodo Payments (sellers); Etsy seller payments; Google Play (developer registration); YouTube Partner Program. Restricted: Paddle lists it as an unsupported seller country; Lemon Squeezy blocks buyers there.

P4_paypal.question: Can residents receive money via PayPal?
P4_paypal.answer: No. North Korea is not on PayPal's list of supported countries/markets, nor on the Payouts list.
